patch.description: Updates all requisition items received in the body. Can be contract items, contract detail items, or change order items.

id.description: The id of the item to update

item_type.description: The type of the item your are updating

work_completed_this_period.description: The amount of work completed this period

materials_presently_stored.description: The amount of materials presently stored

work_completed_retainage_retained_this_p.description: Work completed retainage amount retained this period (admin user only, work_completed_this_period should be non-zero to hold a retainage)

materials_stored_retainage_currently_ret.description: Materials stored retainage amount currently retained (admin user, amount accounting only, materials_presently_stored should be non-zero to hold a retainage)

work_completed_retainage_released_this_p.description: The amount of work completed retainage released this period

work_completed_this_period_quantity.description: Work completed this period quantity (unit accounting contract only)

subcontractor_claimed_amount.description: The total amount the subcontractor original claimed for this line

status.description: Approval status of the invoice line item

comment.description: Comment about the invoice line item

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"requisition_items\":[{\"id\":1001,\"item_type\":1001,\"work_completed_this_period\":1000,\"materials_presently_stored\":500,\"work_completed_retainage_retained_this_period\":0.22,\"materials_stored_retainage_currently_retained\":0.23,\"work_completed_retainage_released_this_period\":0.24,\"work_completed_this_period_quantity\":10,\"subcontractor_claimed_amount\":20.5,\"status\":\"rejected\",\"comment\":\"This work was not yet completed\"}]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/requisitions/%7Brequisition_id%7D/bulk_item_update?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
